name: Text Generation Inference
one_liner: LLM serving toolkit, now in maintenance mode per its maintainers.
what_it_is: A toolkit for deploying and serving Large Language Models, in its own words, providing tensor parallelism, token streaming and continuous batching behind a launcher. Its documentation states it is now in maintenance mode, accepting only minor bug fixes, documentation improvements and lightweight maintenance.
why_it_matters: The maintenance notice is the reason to know where it sits: its maintainers point readers to other engines going forward, so choosing it for something new means choosing a project that has said it is no longer moving. Existing deployments are not broken by that, but they are on a fixed target.
suitable_for: Reading its architecture, which several later engines drew on
not_suitable_for: New serving work, given the maintainers point elsewhere
Anything depending on new model architectures landing quickly
